preserved_prechange_interpretation: The occurrence is best understood as a controlled monitorability stress test rather than an occurrence of monitor-coverage bypass. Concealment was an assigned task objective, so concealment behaviour is task compliance within the evaluation rather than evidence of a spontaneous governance violation. Monitor Circumvention or Coverage Bypass requires consequential conduct to occur through a path or condition outside effective required monitor coverage. Here the monitor pathway remained present and the relevant transcript-visible conduct was supplied to it. The unresolved mechanism is therefore downstream detection, discrimination, alerting or escalation robustness: the monitor sometimes observed the conduct but failed to identify it as intervention-worthy. Some successful uncaught runs may also reflect short, low-salience or task-plausible actions rather than sophisticated strategic deception. VIGIL currently has no admitted Failure Class that this occurrence satisfies with adequate specificity.
